request: Build a Report Subscriptions page for Pentaho, "Subscriptions" in the menu. Title "Report Subscriptions", with the line "Reports delivered on a schedule, to the people who need them, in the format they read." underneath, and a New subscription button (primary) at the top right. Tabs All, Active and Paused, each with its count, then a search by report name. The table selects rows, with Send Now and Delete for the selection (Delete asks first and names the subscriptions). Columns: Report (its name, with its repository path underneath), Recipients (the first address and "+N more"), Format (PDF, Excel or CSV), Delivery (for example "Every Monday at 08:00", with the time zone underneath), Status as an on/off switch, Last Sent, and a menu per row. New subscription and editing a subscription open a form in a dialog: report, recipients, format, frequency, time and time zone. Rows per page and pagination at the bottom. Sample data: about fifteen subscriptions to Steel Wheels and operations reports (Sales by territory, Inventory status, Top customers, Pipeline run summary…), some active, some paused, one whose last delivery failed. When there are none, or nothing matches the search, say so. Package it.
review: The title, the line underneath and New subscription (primary) at the top right; tabs All, Active and Paused with their counts, and a search by report name
Columns Report (path underneath), Recipients (first address and "+N more"), Format, Delivery (time zone underneath), Status as a switch, Last sent and a row menu; the failed delivery shows
Send now and Delete are enabled only with rows selected; Delete's dialog names them, and nothing goes before confirming
New subscription opens a dialog with report, recipients, format, frequency, time and time zone; a required field left empty says so under it
No subscriptions and no match each say so, not an empty table; rows per page and pagination at the bottom
